messages:
alex_pm: Thinking out loud — we need a rollout plan for the "Tiered Degrade" initiative. goal: keep customer-facing apps online under GPU contention by progressively shifting traffic, not hard-killing features. thoughts on launch criteria and flag lifecycle?
cheng_eng: +1. we should define 3 concrete degradation tiers (soft-shed, reduced-context, fallback-model) and the trigger signals. keep it flag-driven with an ordered fallback table.
maria_sre: suggest SLO thresholds: 95th latency > 1.8s for 5m -> enter soft-shed; 95th > 3s for 2m -> reduced-context; sustained queue growth + OOMs -> fallback-model. include circuit-breaker TTL.
priya_data: what telemetry do we need to validate behavior? I want per-route: tokens_saved, successful_fallback_count, user-error-rate, quality-regression-signal (from eval webhook). and sample prompts for offline QA.
tom_pd: business constraints: enterprise customers get opt-out window; beta customers can opt-in for early degrade handling. must have KPs for acceptance: <1% customer-impacting errors during 48h ramp and quality-regressions <= 0.5% on eval set.
cheng_eng: implementation note: flag should encode ordered variants, priority weights, and max-tier. proto rough: ```json
{
  "flag": "tiered_degrade_v1",
  "variants": ["full","soft_shed","reduced_context","fallback_model"],
  "weights": [null, null, null, null],
  "max_tier": 2,
  "ttl_seconds": 300
}
``` will let us roll weights via runtime.
ops_lee: ops needs a clear rollback ladder and playbook. propose automated rollback when "user-error-rate" spikes > 1% and runbook step: 1) set flag to full for affected region 2) drain nodes 3) revert rollout config. also ensure private deployments respect local KMS and won't auto-fallback to hosted-only variants.
maria_sre: also add region-aware gating: EU first, then NA, then APAC. keep canary slice at 0.5% traffic for 30m with telemetry sanity checks.
priya_data: for A/B we should include shadow sampling of requests to monitor quality difference between full vs reduced_context — 5% shadow for 24h is enough for signal. store deltas by customer cohort.
alex_pm: agreement items: 1) define 3-tier thresholds (maria to draft). 2) flag schema + rollout API (cheng to spec). 3) telemetry contract and eval set (priya). 4) enterprise opt-out and customer gating UI (tom + ux). 5) ops rollback playbook (ops_lee). timeline: get spec by EOW, dry-run w/ internal beta next week.
cheng_eng: small engineering constraint: reduced_context requires KV-cache invalidation strategy. will need to preserve session continuity or surface token mismatch fallback. adding task to eng backlog.
ops_lee: note: add a kill-switch that can be toggled at the region level via console + CLI to satisfy sales.
sre-bot: deploybot: new canary policy applied to redwood/tiered-degrade on prod-canary at 1717914050. status: monitoring.
alex_pm: ok thanks — i'm going to draft the rollout playbook with these pieces. i'll post a short spec doc link when ready (will include playbook, flag schema, telemetry fields, and acceptance checklist). :thumbsup:
